topics.focus: Identify SV pattern; intransitive verbs; no object/complement; e.g. Birds fly, He slept.
Transitive verbs with direct object; answer 'what?' after verb; e.g. She wrote a letter.
Linking verbs (be, become, seem) + subject complement; predicate adjective/noun; e.g. He is wise.
Adjunct/adverbial answering how/when/where/why; e.g. They came by bus, She went home.

topics.name_en: Subject + Verb + Indirect Object + Direct Object (SVOO)
topics.name_ta: Subject + Verb + Indirect Object + Direct Object (SVOO)
topics.focus: Double-object pattern (SVIODO/SVDOIO); IO answers to whom, DO answers what; e.g. He gave me a book.
Object + object complement after verbs like made, called, elected; ask 'as what?'; e.g. They made him captain.
